sources.title: Run Gen AI on Qualcomm chipsets with GenieX (formerly NexaSDK)
sources.snippet: GenieX is an open-source runtime for running Generative AI models on Qualcomm devices with a few lines of code - built by the Nexa AI team, which joined Qualcomm through acquisition earlier this year. This article walks through what's included in the Developer Preview and how to run a model across Windows, Android, and Linux.
